entries.description: Completed a Bachelor of Computer Science degree.

Led development of Andal Connect, Andal Linkage, and attendance apps using Flutter, Clean Architecture, and Test-Driven Development. Built reusable packages, revamped CI/CD to reduce deployment time by over 50%, and mentored developers. Implemented a multi-module app and shared dependencies across modules.

Built a permit-management app with two user roles using Flutter, Laravel REST API, and MySQL; added digital-signature validation, resulting in a 50% improvement in approval workflow efficiency after adoption.

projects.title:
Selected work,
from products to models.
projects.aside: Flutter and Android apps, plus a computer-vision study.

items.label: PYTHON · SKIN CLASSIFICATION · 2021
items.title: Skin Disease Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
items.description: The study used an 85:15 train/test split and applied augmentation to training images in the latter two setups.
items.citationText: Dataset reference: Tschandl et al. (2018), Scientific Data 5:180161
items.details: I compared three training setups for an InceptionV3 five-class skin-lesion classifier using 8,964 HAM10000 images: Adam without augmentation, Adam with augmentation, and SGD with augmentation.

items.label: PROFESSIONAL MOBILE APP
items.title: Andal Connect
items.description: Flutter HRIS app for attendance and daily employee workflows. Includes map-based clock-in, silent notifications, and server selection for testing.
items.details: Reworked 60+ Flutter HRIS pages using Clean Architecture. Added Google Maps clock-in/out, silent push notifications, app-version controls, multi-server testing, and unit tests. Rebuilt Codemagic CI/CD; the CV reports a 60% reduction in pipeline runtime.

items.label: PROFESSIONAL DESKTOP APP
items.title: Andal Attendance Machine
items.description: Flutter Desktop app connecting fingerprint attendance machines to Andal services with WebSocket and GraphQL. Built the CI/CD pipeline and added Sentry error reporting.
items.details: Built the Flutter Desktop app from scratch to connect client fingerprint attendance devices to Andal services. Designed the flow across the device, desktop app, and services using WebSocket and GraphQL; built CI/CD and added Sentry error reporting.

items.label: PROFESSIONAL HRIS APP
items.title: Andal Linkage
items.description: Flutter HRIS app used by about 20,000 users. Added Firebase Crashlytics and a feature for users to revise transactions.
items.details: Developed and maintained a Flutter HRIS app serving about 20,000 users. Added Firebase Crashlytics and a transaction-revision feature that lets users edit transactions.

items.label: PYTHON · 皮膚病灶分類 · 2021
items.title: 使用卷積神經網路進行皮膚疾病分類
items.description: 研究以 85:15 比例切分訓練與測試資料，並對後兩種設定的訓練影像進行資料增強。
items.citationText: 資料集文獻：Tschandl 等人（2018），Scientific Data 5:180161
items.details: 我使用 8,964 張 HAM10000 影像，為 InceptionV3 五類皮膚病灶分類比較三種訓練設定：Adam 無資料增強、Adam 有資料增強，以及 SGD 有資料增強。
